verdict.rationale: Namecheap exposes a live public XML API at api.namecheap.com with a separate sandbox endpoint. Its official Go SDK README documents API operations, including domain availability checks, charge-bearing registration and renewal, registrar lock, and TLD capability listing. An official Terraform provider also drives DNS through the API, so the core story is directly delivered. Missing for 10: the first-party API reference documentation itself (the pack holds only error responses from the endpoints), and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: CheckWithContext(ctx, domains...) | Check availability of one or more domains
CreateWithContext(ctx, args) | Register a new domain (charge-bearing)
GetTldListWithContext(ctx) | List all TLDs and their per-TLD API capabilities
A Terraform Provider for Namecheap domain DNS configuration.
